bottleneck: The candidate positive momentum evidence is short-horizon and mechanical; cost robustness remains decision-relevant.

candidate_tasks.bottleneck: Evidence accumulates for one-day holding; temporal robustness is only partially resolved.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A reproducible holding-period robustness artifact plus verification.
candidate_tasks.objective: Test lookback-5 momentum with two predeclared small holding periods (1d / 3d).
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not sweep holding periods after seeing results.
candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does the momentum effect survive more than one fixed holding period?
candidate_tasks.scope: One predeclared holding-period grid, existing 10-asset universe, existing null.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: Holding-period sensitivity is classified and any positive finding is reproducible.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Leakage gate, matched null, independent recomputation, determinism, regression suite.

candidate_tasks.bottleneck: A candidate momentum effect may depend on market regime.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A falsifiable regime-conditioned momentum result with verification.
candidate_tasks.objective: Test one volatility gate on lookback-5 momentum via regime-stability.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not search threshold grids; declare one predeclared gate.
candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does a single past-only volatility gate improve momentum robustness?
candidate_tasks.scope: One past-only volatility feature, one predeclared threshold, existing universe.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The gate either demonstrates reproducible improvement or is falsified.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Leakage gate, matched null, regime-stability, independent recomputation, determinism.

candidate_tasks.bottleneck: Research needs genuinely new signal classes beyond momentum variants.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A reproducible new-signal-class artifact with verification.
candidate_tasks.objective: Test one fixed 20-day breakout continuation rule via existing robustness gates.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not sweep breakout lengths; tune after seeing results.
candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does a fixed 20-day breakout continuation exceed momentum?
candidate_tasks.scope: One predeclared breakout rule, existing data universe, existing research engine.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The hypothesis is classified by evidence standard.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Data preflight, leakage, regime stability, matched null, independent recomputation, determinism, regression suite.

candidate_tasks.bottleneck: A candidate should not depend on uncontrolled sizing assumptions.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A bounded sizing robustness result with verification.
candidate_tasks.objective: Evaluate one fixed volatility-normalized sizing rule for qualified momentum.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not optimize sizing parameters or compare many variants.
candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does volatility-normalized sizing preserve momentum without leverage?
candidate_tasks.scope: One fixed sizing rule, existing universe, existing research engine, no leverage.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: Result distinguishes signal robustness from sizing artifacts.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Leakage, cost assumptions, matched null, independent recomputation, determinism.
